usedFor: Each Calendly booking sends a confirmation or follow-up email from Gmail.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Send Email” in Gmail
bestTemplate.why: It emails the booker the moment they book, with subject, body and attachments you set.

watchOut: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” polls across states, so one person can get several emails.
